feature: Financial workflow reliability and human-reviewed training/document freshness automation

flows.name: Complete the canonical financial journey
steps: Create a project and prime contract with SOV
Add budget lines and lock the budget
Create purchase order and subcontract commitments
Open invoice creation with contract context
flows.expectedOutcome: Every user action reaches its exact API/navigation boundary and the serial journey completes without a dev-server reload

flows.name: Review training discovery and freshness findings
steps: Discover candidates into review status only
Promote repeated freshness evidence to the admin queue
Bridge Keep/Archive feedback into canonical resource memory
Use published and archived examples in future candidate selection
flows.expectedOutcome: Automation never publishes directly, admin decisions are durable, and future selection consumes the good/bad examples

flows.name: Deliver weekday documentation freshness
steps: Run canonical generators in scratch worktrees
Fail after delivery for blocked or failed findings
flows.expectedOutcome: The schedule has a real admin-owned delivery surface and cannot silently report success

checks: The existing training review queue remains the canonical owner
Review feedback is visibly labeled and attached to the candidate
Archive removes the reviewed candidate from the queue

claims.description: The canonical financial workflow completes with exact request and response assertions
Admin candidate and freshness decisions persist feedback without automation bypassing review
Keep/Archive feedback reaches canonical resource memory and future finder selection
Weekday documentation scans deliver an actionable Linear report and verify readback
